commands.doc: Everything app-level a window renders from. Called on open, reload and after a crash.
commands.name: app_snapshot

commands.doc: Ends any Channel subscription (transcript, cards, levels, ask, self-test).
commands.name: stream_unsubscribe

commands.doc:
Acknowledges a Channel up to `seq`, every 100 messages or 1 s (the generated client does it).
 At 2 000 unacknowledged messages the core ends the subscription with `lagged`.
commands.name: stream_ack

commands.doc: UI errors to the local log, never with transcript text.
commands.name: log_ui

commands.doc: Dismiss an app banner (for example "Noter quit during a recording").
commands.name: banner_dismiss

commands.doc:
Start capture (Record, Record as Sensitive, hotkey, menu, Today). Never gated on setup or
 permissions; refused only with `already_recording`, `disk_full` or `model_missing`.
 Allowed while `stopped`: closes the stopped call's Continue window.
commands.name: capture_start

commands.doc: Stop now. The call window shows its closing state; Continue Recording is offered for 5 minutes.
commands.name: capture_stop

commands.doc:
Pause or resume (wanted state). Pause drops audio entirely. Resume of a stopped call is
 refused with `not_recording` (use `capture_continue`).
commands.name: capture_set_paused

commands.doc: Mark a moment.
commands.name: capture_mark_moment

commands.doc: Answer the call-ended notice: Keep Recording or Stop Now.
commands.name: capture_answer_call_end

commands.doc:
Hold the call-ended countdown while the pointer or focus is on the notice (wanted state);
 on release the 10-second countdown starts again.
commands.name: capture_hold_notice

commands.doc:
Continue Recording after any stop, within 5 minutes; appends with a gap row. Cancels the
 queued or running post-call job and queues it again after the next stop (edits are kept).
commands.name: capture_continue

commands.doc:
Resume Recording after Noter quit or crashed mid-call (gap row `interrupted`, allowed while
 the `recording_interrupted_by_quit` banner is shown), or **Try Again** after the engine
 stopped (phase `failed`; gap row `engine_restart`). Continues the same call.
commands.name: capture_resume_interrupted

commands.doc: Answer the new-meeting notice: Start as New Call (default) or Keep in This Call.
commands.name: capture_answer_new_meeting

commands.doc: Keep Recording on the nothing-heard notice; resets the 5-minute timer.
commands.name: capture_keep_recording

commands.doc: Discard Recording (nothing heard), after the inline confirmation.
commands.name: capture_discard

commands.doc: Make This Call Sensitive (during capture), or change it from Call info afterwards.
commands.name: capture_set_sensitive

commands.doc: Exclude a second audio source from the tap.
commands.name: capture_exclude_source

commands.doc: Keep a second audio source in the tap; its banner is not shown again for that app in this call.
commands.name: capture_keep_source

commands.doc: Not Now, × or timed out on the record prompt.
commands.name: capture_dismiss_detection

commands.doc: Don't Ask for <app>… from the prompt's pull-down.
commands.name: capture_ignore_app

commands.doc: Snapshot of a call's transcript, then the live stream for a live call.
commands.name: transcript_subscribe

commands.doc: Microphone and system levels, at most every 100 ms.
commands.name: levels_subscribe

commands.doc: Rename a speaker for the whole call or one line.
commands.name: transcript_rename_speaker

commands.doc: Fix a term; optionally add it to the glossary.
commands.name: transcript_fix_term

commands.doc: Name the speakers after the call (speaker naming panel), skip allowed.
commands.name: transcript_name_speakers

commands.doc: Segments of an evidence span, for the popover and the span preview.
commands.name: transcript_span

commands.doc:
Play audio natively: the engine plays it (D6; no media in the WebView). During capture,
 headphones only.
commands.name: audio_play

commands.doc: Delete the audio of calls (irreversible; native alert first).
commands.name: audio_delete

commands.doc: Delete Old Audio… sheet.
commands.name: audio_delete_older

commands.doc: Visible and earlier cards, pinned items and status, then the card stream.
commands.name: cards_subscribe

commands.doc: Unpin a pinned card; the item the pin created is removed.
commands.name: card_unpin

commands.doc: Undo the last card action (⌃⌥⌘Z equivalent from the panel), within 30 s; then `undo_expired`.
commands.name: card_undo_last

commands.doc: Hovered, focused or expanded: the core never expires a held card.
commands.name: card_set_held

commands.doc: The UI reports when a card was painted (completes the latency measurement).
commands.name: card_shown

commands.doc: Catch Me Up: a solicited catch-up card arrives on the card stream.
commands.name: copilot_catch_up

commands.doc: Ask About This Call…: the answer arrives as a solicited card.
commands.name: copilot_ask_about_call

commands.doc: v1.x screen context chips: returns `feature_disabled` in v1.
commands.name: context_chip_set

commands.doc: Item inspector.
commands.name: item_get

commands.doc: Tick or untick (wanted state). A tick on a suggested item accepts it.
commands.name: item_set_done

commands.doc: Answer the carry-forward "Did the handoff land?": Yes, Landed, Done Another Way or Keep Open.
commands.name: item_answer_handoff_landed

commands.doc: Regenerate sections with another runtime, model or skill; edits are kept and diffed.
commands.name: outputs_regenerate

commands.doc: Copy for Slack, Copy for Jira, Copy as Markdown (the core writes the clipboard, rich and plain).
commands.name: share_copy

commands.doc:
Export… a folder of Markdown, SRT, JSON and audio, for whole calls or a section or selection;
 the core shows the save panel.
commands.name: calls_export

commands.doc:
Generate on demand (cached); `regenerate` forces a new version. Returns at once with state
 `generating`; the result arrives through `entity:changed`.
commands.name: handoff_generate

commands.doc: Stop a prompt that is generating.
commands.name: handoff_cancel

commands.doc:
Open in Claude Code or Codex through the launch path the drawer showed. Accepts a suggested
 item; records the prompt version and whether it was edited.
commands.name: handoff_open

commands.doc: Copy Prompt. Accepts a suggested item; records the prompt version and whether it was edited.
commands.name: handoff_copy

commands.doc: Delete calls for good (native alert first).
commands.name: calls_delete

commands.doc: Hybrid search, sectioned, each hit strong or weak.
commands.name: search

commands.doc: Ask with a scope; the answer streams with citations.
commands.name: ask_start

commands.doc: Keep Separate: never suggest this merge again.
commands.name: topics_keep_separate

commands.doc: Undo a change or a batch. Never expires; rows edited later are kept and counted.
commands.name: change_undo

commands.doc: Redo an undone change or batch, at any time while its rows were not edited later.
commands.name: change_redo

commands.doc: Export Log… for one call or a period (Markdown or JSON); the core shows the save panel.
commands.name: history_export

commands.doc: Unnames their speakers everywhere and deletes the voice profile.
commands.name: person_delete

commands.doc: Edit an agent, including its runtime choice (PM-58). Takes effect at the next tick.
commands.name: agent_update

commands.doc: Only added agents; built-in ones can be disabled, not removed.
commands.name: agent_remove

commands.doc: Replace one section (wanted state).
commands.name: settings_update

commands.doc:
Move the storage folder. Draft: available only if the engine ships unsandboxed (open question Q4);
 with a sandboxed engine audio and models stay in the App Group container.
commands.name: storage_move

commands.doc: Restore Defaults: every app hotkey back to its default shortcut.
commands.name: hotkeys_reset

commands.doc: Add Mapping… from the handoff drawer opens the sheet in the main window.
commands.name: repo_upsert

commands.doc: Privacy pane: what left this Mac, in plain words.
commands.name: audit_list

commands.doc: Screen Share Test…, with the optional capture test (refused during a call).
commands.name: share_test_run

commands.doc: Install a downloaded update now (restarts Noter).
commands.name: update_install

commands.doc: Store or replace a key: verified, then kept in the Keychain; never returned.
commands.name: api_key_set

commands.doc: Sign-in sheet step 1 (Prepare): is the CLI installed, is it already signed in.
commands.name: account_signin_prepare

commands.doc: Install Claude Code, Codex or Ollama (progress on `jobs:progress`).
commands.name: cli_install

commands.doc: Step 2 (Sign in): the CLI opens the browser; progress on `signin:progress`.
commands.name: account_signin_start

commands.doc: Use This Account: bind the sign-in the CLI already has on this Mac.
commands.name: account_use_existing

commands.doc: Step 4 (Use): switch agents to the account, with Undo.
commands.name: account_bind_agents

commands.doc: Sign out in Noter (agents fall back to the API key or pause); optionally in the CLI too.
commands.name: account_sign_out

commands.doc: Run now. Refused with `job_blocked` while a call is live, except post-call analysis (D2).
commands.name: job_run_now

commands.doc: Cancel a queued or running job run.
commands.name: job_cancel

commands.doc: Export the improvement brief or open it in Claude Code or Codex.
commands.name: perf_brief

commands.doc: Ask for a permission at the step that needs it (never mid-call).
commands.name: permission_request

commands.doc: Self-test: levels and a live line stream until passed or failed (10 s).
commands.name: self_test_run

commands.doc: Open Call Screen: shows without focus; a second request makes it key (PM-40).
commands.name: window_show_call

commands.doc: Hide for Presenting (wanted state).
commands.name: app_set_hidden_for_presenting

commands.doc: Show Noter / Open in Noter at a place (main window or Settings window).
commands.name: window_navigate

commands.doc:
The main window reports which call page it shows (`null` = none), so the core sends no
 notification for that call while the window is frontmost.
commands.name: window_report_view

commands.doc: Native announcement for a panel that is not key (D55).
commands.name: window_announce

commands.doc: Open a URL, a document citation, a System Settings pane or a Finder location.
commands.name: open_external

events.doc: The capture state machine, whole, on every change.
events.name: capture:state

events.doc: The record prompt's detection appeared, changed or went away.
events.name: capture:detected

events.doc: Copilot status for every window (menu bar mirrors are native).
events.name: copilot:status

events.doc: Full current set of degraded states.
events.name: degraded:changed

events.doc: Full current set of app banners.
events.name: banners:changed

events.doc: A record changed for any reason; replace it by id.
events.name: entity:changed

events.doc: A post-call output section changed state.
events.name: outputs:progress

events.doc: A job run started, progressed or finished.
events.name: jobs:progress

events.doc: Displays, output route, permissions, notifications, online, update, disk.
events.name: env:changed

events.doc: The core asks the main or Settings window to navigate (notification click, menu).
events.name: nav:request
